name_original: GoPro - HERO+ LCD HD Waterproof Action Camera
description_original: GoPro HERO+ LCD HD Waterproof Action Camera: Capture beautiful 8.0MP shots with this waterproof action camera from GoPro. Hold the shutter button down for burst shooting up to 5 fps (frames per second). GoPro's wearable, mountable design and touch-screen controls make it easy to capture the action from your unique first-person perspective. This GoPro HERO+ LCD action camera also has built-in Wi-Fi and Bluetooth, making it easy to share footage and control the camera remotely.
